onscreen_lines.desc: Provide the percentage discount offered to Choice Partners members for all materials with established or fixed pricing, based on your catalog, publicly available URL pricing, or attached price list.
onscreen_lines.note: Enter the percentage discount offered off the applicable catalog, URL pricing, or price list. If discounts vary, enter the applicable discount or discount range and provide additional details in the “Add Notes” box. Clearly identify any products, manufacturers, or product categories associated with different discount percentages. All materials with established or fixed pricing should be included under Line 2.

onscreen_lines.desc: Provide your cost-plus percentage/markup for materials that do not have established or fixed pricing and therefore cannot be priced using the percentage discount method in Line 2.
onscreen_lines.note: Clearly identify the products, manufacturers, product categories, or specific circumstances that require cost-plus pricing in Pricing List for MRO Parts / Equipment attachment. Line 4 should not be used for materials that have established catalog, URL, or price-list pricing and can be priced under Line 2. If elected, you must include an additional statement with pricing document. Please refer to the Cost-Plus Pricing attachment for additional instructions.
